title: LCMV Beamformer
text: 窄带线性约束最小方差 (LCMV) 波束形成器，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；{Constraint matrix} 指定 LCMV 波束形成器约束矩阵 complex、{Desired response vector} 指定 LCMV 波束形成的期望响应、{Diagonal loading factor} 指定对角加载因子 positive scalar、{Enable training data input} 启用训练数据输入端口、{Enable weights output} 启用波束形成器权重输出、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 输入信号 M -by- N complex-valued matrix

ports.name: XT
ports.summary: 训练信号 P -by- N complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 波束成形输出 M -by-1 complex-valued column vector

ports.name: W
ports.summary: 波束形成器权重输出 N -by-1 complex-valued column vector

params.name: Constraint matrix
params.values: LCMV 波束形成器约束矩阵 complex([1;1]) (default) | N -by- K complex-valued matrix

params.name: Desired response vector
params.values: LCMV 波束形成的期望响应 1 (default) | real-valued K -by-1 column vector

params.name: Diagonal loading factor
params.values: 对角加载因子 positive scalar

params.name: Enable training data input
params.values: 启用训练数据输入端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Enable weights output
params.values: 启用波束形成器权重输出 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
